workarounds.workaround: Fix: openai: omit `input_fidelity` when `None` in image generation tool. Target files: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/models/openai.py, tests/models/test_openai_responses.py. OpenAI's `gpt-image-2` model rejects requests that include `input_fidelity: null`. Pydantic AI was unconditionally passing `input_fidelity` to the OpenAI Responses API even when the user had not explicitly set it, causing a 400 error for `gpt-image-2` users. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/5415)

workarounds.symptom: Image output validators not called and `wrap_validation_errors` bug
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: run output validators for image outputs. Target files: pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/_agent_graph.py, pydantic_ai_slim/pydantic_ai/result.py, tests/test_agent.py. - Image outputs (`BinaryImage`) bypassed `@agent.output_validator` in both non-streaming and streaming paths, while text outputs properly called them - Fix `wrap_validation_errors=False` for image validator calls so `ModelRetry` is properly caught instead of being wrapped in `ToolRetryError` - Add validator loop to the streaming image path in `result.py` (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/4938)
